prompt:
Use the first reference image for the cooked beef roll character (light pink cooked marbled beef roll, googly eyes, small toothless smiling mouth, tiny pale arms) relaxing in the broth, and for the same single big round dark iron hotpot (no dividers), glossy red chili oil broth, chili and Sichuan peppercorn characters, wooden table and warm lantern-lit Chongqing restaurant. Use the second reference image for the pair of wooden chopsticks lying on the left pot rim and sticking out over the broth like a diving board, and for the camera: about 40 degrees above, wide framing showing about 90% of the pot including rim and both handles. New character: a piece of beef tripe (毛肚, Chongqing hotpot black tripe): a dark grey-black sheet covered in many small soft finger-like papillae, realistic texture, with googly eyes, a small toothless mouth wide open in a thrilled scream, and tiny dark arms and legs. A long fresh green scallion stalk is tied around its waist like a bungee cord, the other end knotted to the tip of the chopsticks. New moment: the tripe has just bungee-jumped off the chopsticks and is falling head-first toward the boiling broth, arms stretched forward, the green scallion cord trailing behind it from the chopstick tip, about to dip into the broth. In the broth below, the cooked beef roll sits up and cheers with both tiny arms raised; the chili and peppercorn characters look up, excited, pointing. Photorealistic textures, glistening oil, warm red and amber tones, cute food-character animation in a photorealistic style, appetizing, film grain. No comic motion lines or symbols, no humans, no human hands, no text, no logos.
画面要求：背景不透明，纸面或底色铺满整个画面，不要透明、镂空或黑色边角区域。
